what_this_is: The rerun the withdrawn note asked for. The 2026-09-19 run detected every figure with red and blue exchanged and its box verdicts were withdrawn. The corpus was refetched from the same 28 papers and every one of the 182 figures is byte-identical to the committed record (sha256), both detectors hash-identical to the ones the spike ran, and detect was rerun through the fixed harness, which converts to BGR. Box totals reproduce exactly the BGR totals the review predicted: 371 for v1 and 148 for v2 over the 182 figures.
labelled_by: One reader, from the per-model overlays, 2026-09-20. Every figure on which v2 drew a box was looked at: the 17 region-bearing ones, the 7 region-bearing ones it did not box, and -- added 2026-09-20 after review pointed out that the first version of this record had only COUNTED them -- the 4 figures with no region that it boxed anyway, listed under v2_false_box_figures_inspected. v1's boxes were NOT judged box by box and only its counts are reported here, so any v1 recall quoted from this file is an upper bound. The region counts are the 2026-09-19 reader's and are reused unchanged, which is what makes this a rerun of the boxes rather than a fresh measurement.
